verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence confirm AnythingLLM runs fully locally with no cloud dependency, supports Ollama/llama.cpp out of the box, and the developer explicitly confirms local/private-by-default with cloud use being opt-in (anythingllm-comm-3, anythingllm-comm-5, anythingllm-comm-11, anythingllm-docs-1/2/15). Missing for 10: explicit documentation or community confirmation of LM Studio and vLLM as supported backends (only Ollama/llama.cpp are directly evidenced).
